About

Applied econometrics for energy and finance policy

My work sits where energy economics, environmental economics and finance meet. I ask practical questions: who bears energy-price shocks, how risk travels between energy and financial markets, and which financial instruments actually move investment toward clean energy.

Before research, I spent eight years in retail and trade banking in Karachi, including foreign-trade management at Summit Bank. That background shapes how I model pricing and financing decisions as institutions and households actually make them. I have led a policy-oriented research grant from proposal to dissemination as Principal Investigator for the CAREC Institute, and I now teach economics and finance at Bahçeşehir Cyprus University.

Research

Three research streams

Stream 1

Energy markets and economic resilience

Energy-price volatility, market interconnectedness and shocks, and how they pass into exchange rates, equity and debt markets, and the wider economy.

  • Energy price volatility and exchange-rate instability
  • European energy markets after COVID-19
  • Geopolitical risk and China's energy markets
Stream 2

Energy transition and sustainable finance

Green bonds, clean-energy investment, fintech and digital currencies, and financial globalisation as channels that help or hold back sustainable investment.

  • Green bonds and clean-energy investment
  • Fintech, digital currencies and renewable stocks
  • Energy poverty and affordability
Stream 3

Climate policy and sustainable development

How institutional quality, policy design and market-based instruments shape environmental outcomes, including emission trading in Central Asia.

  • Emission trading in CAREC economies
  • Governance, economic freedom and SDG 3
  • Circular economy and resource efficiency
Emerging agenda

Digital transformation and AI

I am extending this work to how AI, digitalisation and financial technology affect productivity, resource efficiency, investment and environmental outcomes, including the electricity demands of AI infrastructure.

Methods & skills

Policy-relevant empirical methods

Each method is matched to the policy question it answers and to published work where I have applied it.

MethodPolicy question it answersApplied in

Quantile and quantile-on-quantile regression

QR · QQR · multivariate QQR · quantile kernel regression

Do policies work differently for the most vulnerable or the most polluting? Effects across the whole distribution, not only the average case.

Energy poverty in Spain (Energy Economics, 2025); energy patents and emissions (Clean Tech. & Env. Policy, 2026)

Wavelet and time-frequency analysis

Wavelet coherence · Morlet wavelets · wavelet quantile correlation · local multiple correlation

Is a policy or price shock a short-run disturbance or a long-run structural shift? Which horizon should policy target?

Energy prices and exchange rates (Energy, 2025); carbon neutrality in China (Prog. Nuclear Energy, 2024)

Connectedness and spillover models

Time-varying connectedness · contagion · extreme-quantile spillovers

How do shocks spread between energy, financial and currency markets, and where should regulators watch for systemic risk?

European energy markets (Applied Energy, 2025); Evergrande contagion (IREF, 2025); geopolitical risk (IRFA, 2025)

Panel econometrics

Fixed/random effects · dynamic panels · nonlinear and threshold models · cross-country panels

Which institutional, financial and technology conditions drive green growth and resource efficiency across countries?

Governance and SDG 3 (Sustainable Development, 2026); outward FDI and green energy (IREF, 2026)

Time-series causality

Bootstrap rolling-window causality · NARDL · QARDL · asymmetric models

Did a relationship change after a policy, crisis or regime shift? Are responses to increases and decreases symmetric?

Green innovation and the UK energy transition (Sustainable Development, 2023, Wiley Top Cited)

Policy assessment and scenario analysis

Policy design review · scenario and simulation analysis · comparative country case studies

What are the barriers to adopting a market-based instrument, and which pathway fits a country's institutions?

Emission trading in Kazakhstan and China (CAREC Institute, 2025)

Survey and firm-level modelling

SEM · SmartPLS · SPSS

What drives firm and household adoption of green finance, fintech and sustainable practices?

Firm- and survey-level studies

Bibliometric and systematic review

Science mapping · co-citation and keyword networks

Where does the evidence base stand, and what research gaps should funders and policymakers prioritise?

Energy price volatility and green finance (Energy, 2024)
